scripts.android:sync: tsc -b && vite build --mode android && node scripts/check-android-bundle.mjs dist && cap sync android
scripts.android:build: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:run: npm run android:sync && ANDROID_HOME=${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Android/Sdk} cap run android
scripts.android:release: tsc -b && VITE_API_BASE_URL=https://api.loonietoonietracker.com vite build --mode android && node scripts/check-android-bundle.mjs dist --release https://api.loonietoonietracker.com && NODE_ENV=production cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
